verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs explicitly describe natural-language debugging workflows — reproducing issues, narrowing root causes, verifying fixes, tracing codebase structure, inspecting diffs, and running checks (cursor-docs-1, cursor-docs-3, cursor-docs-4) — and Bugbot extends this to automated bug/security detection in PRs via NL-driven review (cursor-supp-bugbot). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence validating debugging accuracy or effectiveness in practice, and more detail on how root-cause analysis is surfaced conversationally beyond marketing-style doc snippets.
